_about: A model of how the Load orders pipeline starts. schedules lists its schedules; triggers lists its storage event triggers. Parameters passed to the pipeline go under parameters, by name.

parameters.file_name: the file to load, for an incremental run

needs: A full reload every night at 02:00 Amsterdam time, from 7 November 2026 to the end of 2027.
An incremental load whenever a new .csv file lands in the orders folder of the partner's Azure Blob Storage container, loading just that file. Deleted files must not start a run.
